NDIS cleaning and domestic assistance

NDIS Household Tasks

Reliable help to keep your home clean, safe and comfortable, from everyday cleaning and laundry to domestic assistance that fits around your week.

Also known as NDIS cleaning and domestic assistance

A clean, safe home without the stress

NDIS household tasks is practical help to keep your home clean, safe and functional when everyday chores have become a barrier. It is what many people search for as NDIS cleaning, house cleaning or domestic assistance.

It is all delivered by the same reliable team, on a schedule that suits you, so your home stays comfortable without the stress.

  • Regular cleaning, laundry and tidying
  • Meal preparation and grocery support
  • Respectful, consistent workers in your home

Ask about household support

Send a quick enquiry and we will call you back within one business day.

We usually reply within one business day, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Your details are used only to respond to your enquiry.

What you receive

What NDIS household tasks includes

We tailor the visit to your home and your preferences. Common tasks include the following.

General cleaning

Vacuuming, mopping, dusting and wiping down. Regular cleaning that keeps your home fresh and safe to move around.

Kitchen and bathroom

Cleaning the rooms that matter most for hygiene, including benches, sinks, the bathroom and the toilet.

Laundry and linen

Washing, drying, folding and putting away, plus fresh linen and bed changes so daily life stays comfortable.

Meal preparation support

Help planning and preparing simple meals, safe food handling and keeping the kitchen usable.

Grocery shopping and errands

Shopping with you or on your behalf, plus everyday errands so the essentials are always covered.

Decluttering and safety

Reducing clutter and trip hazards, rubbish removal and keeping key areas of the home easy to use.

Your schedule

Support on a rhythm that suits your week

Some people need a weekly reset. Others want a hand before a family visit, after a hospital stay, or at the change of season. You choose the rhythm.

Weekly Fortnightly One off deep tidy Before or after events Seasonal reset After a hospital stay
Who it helps

When household tasks support helps most

Household tasks support fits best when day to day chores are getting in the way of your health, independence or routine.

  • When fatigue, pain or a disability make chores hard or unsafe
  • During recovery, so you can rest while the home stays on track
  • When you want to build skills and confidence at home
  • Alongside personal care, for complete support under one team
Getting started

How household support starts

Enquire

Tell us about your home, the tasks you want help with and your NDIS plan.

Quick chat or visit

A short call or visit to understand your preferences and priorities.

Set your schedule

We agree the tasks, frequency and visit length that suit you.

Start and review

Support begins with the same trusted worker, and we adjust as needs change.

The Ahsan difference

Support matched to how you live

A person is coming into your home, so trust matters. We match you with a worker who respects your space, your culture and the way you like things done, and we keep it the same familiar person where we can.

LanguageWorkers who speak your language
Gender preferenceMale or female workers as you prefer
Culture and faithRespect for your background and beliefs
Routine and continuityThe same familiar faces, your way
Funding and pricing

How this support is funded

If it is a reasonable and necessary support in your NDIS plan, this service is funded from your plan budget. Household tasks is usually funded under Core Supports, Assistance with Daily Life, and covers what is reasonable and necessary in your plan.

  • Plan managed, self managed and NDIA managed participants are all welcome
  • Pricing follows the NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits, and your Government Approved Budget
  • No call out fee and no lock in contracts
  • The same trusted worker wherever possible, at no extra charge

NDIS pricing arrangements

Getting a quote is simple.

Tell us your plan management type and the support you are after. We will explain what can be claimed and provide a clear service agreement before anything starts. There are no surprises and no obligation.

Request a free quote

Clear boundaries

Household tasks or household maintenance

Light, regular home help is household tasks. Heavier or occasional work sits with a different support, so your cleaning time is not used up.

Household tasks covers

Regular cleaning, laundry, meal prep, shopping and keeping the home safe and tidy.

Household maintenance covers

Heavier yard work, gardening and minor repairs. See our household maintenance support for those jobs.
